findings.summary: Billing's blocks no longer share one right edge. The plan cards and the invoices table span the controls column (x 640 to 1312), but the saved payment card stops at x 1200, the form width, so a ragged edge runs down the screen. This goes against the spec ('Wide blocks inside a settings section (cards, grids, tables) span the controls column's full width'), and it is worse than published 1.1.0, where the same payment card spans the column like the blocks above and below it. The visible miss is small (112px), but the brief rates anything worse than the published version at least major, and with one sample it counts. The spec names the rule; the agent applied the form cap (`size.form`) to a single card instead. The spec does not say which blocks count as 'wide' versus form-width, so a one-row card reads as either.
findings.promptFix: Settings layout: 'Only form inputs (and a live preview that sits with them) stop at `size.form`. Every other block in the controls column (a card for a saved item or connected account, a grid of choices, a list, a table) ends at the column's right edge, even when it holds a single row. Verification: on each settings screen at 1440px, every non-form block has the same right x.'

findings.summary: On the article page, the in-body plate (FIG 0.1, perspective grid) shares its kind with the Related card for 'Writing Release Notes People Actually Read' (perspective grid, FIG 02), so the same figure type appears twice on one page. The spec rules out shared kinds only in a grid row or column and between adjacent list items. Published 1.1.0 also showed this, so it is not a regression.
The project detail's mono meta reads 'PROJECT 01 · APOLLO-MIGRATION', which repeats the h1 right below it as a slug. The meta label carries the record's kind and number but no new fact.

notes: Scope: screen step, one sample per app (<app>/20261019-011443). All gates pass (eval-1.md); the smoke tests were not run for this evaluation and run at the confirm step. Palette consistency is 1.0 and type consistency 0.82. Compared with published 1.1.0 (carried from 1.1.0-rc.7, S0 = 1.1.0-rc.7/<app>/20261018-022713) and with 1.2.0-rc.1 critic-1.

Update goal (iterations.md, 1.2.0-rc.2), reached on both points. (1) Page close: blog home and about now end in the centered two-tone statement 'Follow along. By email.' over the dot field, with the mono label above and the existing form under it. The article page closes the same way. The success state keeps the statement and swaps the form for a small blueprint and a two-tone line. The store grid, cart, dashboard and settings pages end without one, as the trigger says. (2) Plate captions: store cards now carry one real detail from the item's own data that the card does not show ('18 OZ', '22 L', '45 L', 'REG FIT', '240 GSM', 'TWILL', '350 ML', 'OVEN SAFE', '50×70 CM', 'BRASS', 'ONE SIZE'; all in products.ts details). The item detail lists every detail, so its caption falls back to the kind name ('FIG 01 · TOTE', 'FIG 04 · SWEATER'), as the rule asks. Blog captions use one kind of fact across the list ('k PARTS', the post's section count, per agent-report). The project plate reads '4 PEOPLE', not the status. The rc.1 minor about a plate on the payment card is gone: billing shows a plain card row.

rc.1 critic-1 majors: both fixed (see the goal note). Regressions vs published 1.1.0: only finding 1. Still held: 48px settings-group rhythm, ranked plan cards with 1-2-3 slabs, mobile tables with two columns and status pinned, the error banner directly above the actions (checkout, profile), indigo focus ring over the red error border, empty dot glyph with 'NO RESULTS', the empty-cart blueprint, chart-in at 420ms with teal current column on a quiet stage (motion-m1), a marching connector on the about pair (motion-about-m1, bp-dash 1000ms linear), and the row of three captioned blueprints level.

Measured layout defect, commerce / repeated-drawing (desktop and mobile): false alarm. Kinds repeat only after all eight are used, and each repeat is a different figure on its crop (bars home-d6 'TWILL' vs home-d11 'ONE SIZE'; the waves and the square grids differ the same way). Same result as rc.1.

Known, not re-raised (earlier minors): the 'Deployment throughput' title above its stage vs 'Recent activity' titled inside its card, which starts the two panels on different lines; the danger dot on improving trends ('−2 since Monday', '−0.6 days'); the specKinds diagonal echo in the store grid; and the blueprint craft using clean single outlines instead of the reference's ribbed tiers.

Capture artifacts, not penalized: the dialog backdrop cut at y≈900 in settings state-plan-dialog-desktop-light.png. Faint color fringes on body text in the scaled article capture are subpixel antialiasing.

Scores, descriptive. Reference fidelity 4: near-black and paper grounds, inverse pills, tight Inter, mono uppercase labels, split two-tone openers, hairline grids, the teal current column on a quiet stage, and the centered closing over dots (vs p1-desktop-light.png, 'Built for the future. Available today.'). Cross-app 4: the screen heads, mono counts, banners and plates are shared. Hierarchy 4. Spacing 4: one ragged edge on billing (finding 1). Component states 4. Polish 4. Signature 4: all six pieces are present and built to recipe, the dot-field close is back where a page ends in an action, and the captions now inform.

Verdict basis: one sample, so the single major (finding 1) counts and the screen does not pass. It is an agent slip against an existing rule, small in pixels but a regression vs published. The fix is a clarifying sentence and a verification check, with no change to the design language. Both goals of the update were reached.
